name: tier_evidence_distill_user
content: Distill this {domain} roll-up into an evidence-record proposal per the system contract. Promote only if it evidences substantive work; otherwise skip.

variables.name: domain
variables.description: Short hint for the nature of the source roll-up, e.g. 'meeting', 'email day', 'calendar day'.

variables.name: record_json
variables.description: The metadata-only roll-up JSON for one (key/account, day) — e.g. { account, day, subjects[], senders[], thread_count, summary } for email, or { summary, decisions[], action_items[] } for a meeting.

metadata.description: Generic user prompt carrying ONE producer roll-up (meeting/email/calendar/future) to distill. One prompt for every tier connector — the producer is parameterized by {domain}.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial generic tier-roll-up distillation user prompt (replaces per-producer prompts).
